title: review follow-ups of PR #37675: retired i18n route-owner wording in spec/client docblocks; skill nits on plugin wiring and source locale
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgV6i8jfWwSXjpWJrjA

Filing gate: ① (review follow-ups, one card per PR) · Source: fleet (Contract review record 7203257460 on PR #37675, nits N1–N3 and its out-of-diff note, adopted at ACCEPT)

## What happens

PR #37675 (card #37625) corrects the `objectstack-i18n` skill and two spec comments: the three locale routes are mounted by the runtime HTTP dispatcher and served from whichever i18n provider fills the slot. Its review left these items open; none could be fixed on that head without moving it (the skill sits at its token ceiling).

- [ ] **The retired route-owner fact is still stated outside that diff** (N1). `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts` still says it in the `ResolvedFieldLabel` docblock ("service-i18n's autonomous route") and the `normalizeSupportedLocales` docblock ("either one can be the thing mounting `GET /i18n/locales`"); the same wording sits in `packages/client/src/index.ts` and `i18n-resolver.test.ts`. Expected: name the dispatcher as the mounter, as #37675 did.
- [ ] **"Don't wire this plugin" reads as a prohibition** (N2). Explicit `new I18nServicePlugin({ localesDir })` wiring is supported (`os serve` skips auto-registration when it is present). Expected: restore the statement form ("You do not need to wire…") when tokens allow.
- [ ] **`getSourceLocale()` is listed bare** (N3). It returns only the declared value (`undefined` otherwise), while the same skill's config table says `sourceLocale` defaults to `defaultLocale`. Expected: one clause saying what the getter returns when nothing is declared.
- [ ] **Registration sentence omits two facts** (out-of-diff note). The three routes answer signed-in callers only, and the locales answer also carries `fallbackChain` (`packages/runtime/src/domains/i18n.ts`). Expected: say both, if the budget can pay for them.

Category ①: docs and skill text that teach a stale or incomplete fact.
Priority: p3 (comments and skill wording; no shipped behaviour changes).
Business reason: an app author or agent following the skill or the spec comments would look for the routes in the wrong plugin, or read `getSourceLocale()` as always returning a locale.
Reader: the dev who next edits the i18n skill or `i18n-resolver.ts`.
Dedupe: searched open issues for `"PR #37675"`: 0 hits.
Related: #37625, PR #37675.

## Grade

area:ux · Bug · minor · reach: read (the head against `main`) · evidence: read → p3
